output.review_comment: Request changes: (1) Missing `import math` statement - code will fail at runtime. (2) The special case for `p == 50` with even-length arrays using linear interpolation, while other percentiles use nearest-rank method, appears to be test-specific logic rather than a consistent implementation of the documented algorithm. The docstring should specify one percentile calculation method that applies consistently. Either this special case shouldn't exist, or the entire algorithm needs to be reviewed against what the docstring actually specifies.
